title: Task Calendar
caption: A local calendar for your terminal.

title: A calendar for your terminal
caption: Local. Keyboard driven. Ready inside Kitty and tmux.

title: Make room for focused work
caption: Day view shows overlaps, free time and the current-time line.

title: Your week, at a glance
caption: h / l navigate ranges. Multi-day tasks stay one continuous task.

title: A longer perspective
caption: Month view keeps spanning work connected across weeks.

title: All twelve months
caption: y opens Year. Schedule work across months and even across years.

title: Capture first. Plan later.
caption: a + a title + Enter. Unscheduled work belongs in Inbox.

title: Give the task its details
caption: Dates, priority, tags, notes and recurrence. Ctrl-S saves.

title: Everything in one place
caption: Enter opens the full schedule and notes. Esc returns to your calendar.

title: Your actions set the state
caption: s starts. x completes. p returns to pending. Notifications never change state.

title: Move the plan, keep the duration
caption: r accepts +1h, +1d, +1w, tomorrow, or a new date.

title: Delete is easy to recover
caption: Click Delete or press D. Press u to bring the task back.

title: Find the work that matters
caption: / searches titles, notes, tags and dates. f filters the visible calendar.

title: A routine, without the re-entry
caption: Complete one occurrence. Tomorrow remains pending. E edits the series.

title: Keep the history
caption: H keeps completed work searchable, including older archived tasks.

title: Help is always close
caption: ? opens searchable commands. Type an action to find its shortcut.

title: One more reminder, when you choose
caption: z snoozes once for 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60 minutes.

title: At home in tmux
caption: Resize or split the terminal. Your selection and unsaved draft are preserved.

title: Quick capture from the shell
caption: The CLI, calendar and reminder process share the same local database.

title: Reminders, with the calendar closed
caption: A real desktop reminder at T minus 15 minutes. Demo clock advanced to 16:45.

title: Start time, without notification spam
caption: Demo clock advanced to 17:00. One start notification; the task remains pending.
